name: get_domain_project_domains
description:
List all project domains associated with an apex domain owned by the authenticated account.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/domains/{domain}/project-domains --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

limit.description: Maximum number of project domains to list from a request.

since.description: Get project domains created after this JavaScript timestamp.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.

until.description: Get project domains created before this JavaScript timestamp.
